g.text: Thirty-second forecasts of source-reported Pamplona density
AR(1) fit on 2022; local trend fit per origin. Forecasts use their recorded target timestamps.
2023 paired ΔMAE, m⁻² (model − persistence): Local trend +0.009 [-0.001, +0.018]; AR(1) +0.424 [+0.284, +0.588]
2024 paired ΔMAE, m⁻² (model − persistence): Local trend +0.005 [-0.005, +0.015]; AR(1) +0.372 [+0.251, +0.505]

Each point is one 30 s forecast scored against the source-reported density at that same target time. Lower error delta favors the compared model; zero means equal absolute error. Bootstrap intervals are conditional descriptive
summaries (1,000 circular moving-block resamples, 5 origins, seed 0), not significance or generalization claims.

One venue. This is not a crowd-crush warning evaluation or an independent density-accuracy result. Data: Gu, Guiselin & Bartolo, Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14050598, CC BY 4.0. Original repository code: MIT.
